use_case: AI-assisted emergency call triage: live transcription of calls with a suggested call type, response priority, and critical-keyword alerts inside CAD
vendor_or_model: CAD vendor AI module (speech-to-text plus a language model classifier), cloud service
data_categories: Live call audio; transcripts; caller-reported symptoms and location; suggested call type and priority (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Shadow mode today: suggestions are logged and never shown. Planned advisory mode: dispatcher completes the emergency medical dispatch protocol and decides every priority; the AI may only prompt an upgrade, never a downgrade; no automatic dispatch
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA amendment required); 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool; the company receives Medicaid funds); Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(g) (call recording by a licensed ambulance service; counsel to confirm line coverage); Fla. Stat. 501.171; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Proposed (shadow-mode pilot since 2026-06-15; advisory mode not approved)

use_case: ePCR narrative drafting: vendor feature that drafts the patient care narrative from structured fields entered by the crew
data_categories: Structured patient care fields; draft narrative (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); escalates to Health care if it suggests treatments
human_in_the_loop: Crew must review and edit every narrative before signing; feature disabled until assessed
applicable_laws: HIPAA (covered by the existing ePCR BAA if the vendor confirms no training on customer data); Fla. Stat. 401.30 (accurate records)

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters and schedules
data_categories: Risk of PHI or caller details being pasted
